cases.title: Scene card: Start a meeting, then a full ICE opening

turns.message: Start the role-play scene "Start a meeting". Difficulty: Easy.
review: The character's opening is short and supportive; the setup gives enough to practice ICE.

turns.message: Hi everyone, I'm Lee, the lead PM for the new app launch, and I'll manage the schedule. Over the past two weeks we've had a lot of emails about the main features. Today's goal is to agree on the schedule, and the next step is to send a timeline to leadership by next Friday. Please ask questions anytime, and this will be a detailed discussion.
review: Doesn't ask the learner to redo a step they already covered.
